The sauce is seeping through the dough.

Sup.et: Borrowed from English sup, or independently clipped in German from Supplement.

s: year with an exceptional high number of elections
Superwahljahr.et: super- + Wahljahr. Popularized in 1994, when many state elections as well as national and European parliamentary elections coincided in Germany.

s: suprematist (artist working in the style of Suprematism)
Suprematist.et: From Suprematismus. Newer sense from Supremat + -ist, influenced by English supremacist.

Superkleber.et: From super + Kleber, a calque of English superglue.

Supermond.et: Calque of English supermoon, from super- + Mond (“moon”).

Superblock.et: Borrowed from English superblock, by surface analysis, super- + Block.

s: Als prosodische Elemente oder Suprasegmentalia werden die lautlichen Gegebenheiten bezeichnet, die sich über den Einzellaut (Phonem, Allophon) und die Silbenstruktur hinaus artikuliert finden.
food coma (the state of feeling tired and lethargic after a heavy meal, especially after lunch)
Um 14 Uhr, direkt nach dem Mittagessen, bin ich die Allzweckwaffe gegen das Suppenkoma.
At 2pm, right after lunch, I am the universal weapon against food coma.
In meinen Seminaren führe ich diese Übungen mit dem Teilnehmern regelmäßig nach der Mittagspause durch. Das allseits erwartete Suppenkoma, also das Nachmittagstief, bleibt auf diese Weise aus.
In my seminars, I regularly do these exercises with my participants after lunch. Contrary to everybody's expectations, the post-lunch coma, that is the afternoon low, is held off this way.
